==========================================================================================
  LUNAR SOUTH POLE CRATER TO PRADAN SAR DATA FILE MAPPING
==========================================================================================

Generated from:
  - LROC_PSR_SouthPole_80to85S.csv (164 PSRs)
  - PRADAN CH2 SAR.xlsx (2,892 south pole SAR files)

Method: For each PSR, SAR files with center coordinates within 100 km were matched.
        Results are grouped by crater name extracted from 'Nearby_Features'.

NOTE: PSRs at latitudes -80° to -83° have fewer nearby SAR files because most
      CH2 SAR acquisitions are centered around -87° to -89° latitude.
      PSRs south of -85° have excellent coverage.
